name: beacon
description: Beacon: a web-based training and support platform for university peer supporters (ALU capstone pilot).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
